title: Final Fantasy XII: The Zodiac Age
synopsis: The Zodiac Age remaster of Ivalice’s war — retained as Square Enix’s Nintendo Switch game card.

curatorNotes:
Final Fantasy XII follows Vaan, a street thief in occupied Rabanastre, into Princess Ashe’s resistance against the Archadian Empire in the world of Ivalice. The Zodiac Age remaster adds the twelve-class Zodiac Job System, a high-speed mode, auto-saves, and a re-recorded soundtrack.

It released on Nintendo Switch on April 30, 2019.

The filing joins the Final Fantasy lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Square Enix’s retail edition of Final Fantasy XII: The Zodiac Age on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Final Fantasy XII released on PlayStation 2 in Japan on March 16, 2006. The Zodiac Age released on PlayStation 4 in July 2017, and on Nintendo Switch on April 30, 2019 (HAC-P-APSWA).
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Square Enix, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
